text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, or TDD, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and improve design. Although writing tests takes extra time, it gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they can change or add code without fear of breaking something. In short, good testing leads to more reliable software and happier teams.
